newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 12.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Traffic to be cut by half in Paris on days of heavy pollution.

-- The terms and conditions for the privatisation of Thomson-CSF published today says it expect electronics hub to develop around Thomson-CSF. There are no restrictions on the nationality of potential bidders, bidders need at least five billion francs equity to be eligible. The successful bidder to be chosen by June 30.
-- Aerospatiale to be excluded from bidding for Thomson-CSF in alliance with Alcatel Alsthom on grounds that Aerospatiale is a state-owned company.
-- Renault European staff demonstrate at Billancourt Paris suburb against planned plant shut-down and job cuts. EU parliamentarians join in criticism.
-- French chemicals industry expects three percent growth in activity in 1997.
-- Chargeurs International posts 136 million francs profit for 1996, partly due to restructuring.
